description: Sandbox secret leases (spec §3.14). A sandbox that is not a vault member seals the subject {secrets:[{var,ref}],purpose?} to seal_pub[key_epoch] (seal-key.json seal_keys, vault shared) and signs the request with its own request key; shared = X25519(esk, seal_pub); key = HKDF-SHA256(ikm=shared, salt=epk || seal_pub, info=utf8("akv1/lease-request"), L=32); aad = cjson({"ctx":"akv1/lease-request","lease_id","vault_id","key_epoch","account","requester","lease_pub","ttl_s","ts","expires_at"}); sig = Ed25519(request key) under "akv1/lease-request" over the wire minus sig; requester = kid(requester_key). The lease code is digest = b64(SHA-256(cjson(request wire, sig included))). A grant is signed by the approving device under "akv1/lease-grant"; allow seals {secrets:[{var,value}]} to lease_pub: shared = X25519(esk, lease_pub); key = HKDF-SHA256(ikm=shared, salt=epk || lease_pub, info=utf8("akv1/lease-seal"), L=32); aad = cjson({"ctx":"akv1/lease-seal","lease_id","vault_id","account","requester","lease_pub","request_digest","approver","ts","expires_at"}); expires_at defaults to ts + ttl_s*1000. requests: sealLeaseRequest with the given esk, nonce wire.n and lease_id MUST reproduce wire byte for byte; openLeaseRequest(SealSK[key_epoch], wire, {vault_id, account, lease_code: digest}) MUST yield subject; leaseRequestDigest MUST equal digest. openLeaseRequest order: parse (v or alg unknown: unsupported_version; exact keys, IDs, requester = kid(requester_key), lease_pub/epk 32 B, n 24 B, ct 16..16400 B, sig 64 B, ttl_s 60..86400, expires_at > ts: bad_request); vault_id or account other than expected (bad_request); signature under requester_key (invalid_signature); digest other than lease_code (forbidden); AEAD (decrypt_failed); subject not canonical, unknown or missing keys, 1..32 secrets, var ^[A-Z_][A-Z0-9_]{0,127}$, unique vars, ref 1..4096, purpose 1..200 (bad_request). grants: signLeaseGrant by approver alice-laptop over requests[0].wire with the given esk and nonce MUST reproduce grant byte for byte; openLeaseGrant(lease_secret, grant, requests[0].wire, {now, requested_vars: the request vars}) MUST yield payload (or deny). openLeaseGrant order: parse (unsupported_version / bad_request; approver = kid(approver_key); allow has exactly expires_at, epk, n, ct and deny none); lease_id, vault_id, account, requester or request_digest other than the request (bad_request); ts outside [request.ts, request.expires_at) or expires_at > ts + ttl_s*1000 (bad_request); approver = requester (forbidden); signature under approver_key (invalid_signature); approver outside a pinned approvers set (forbidden); deny returns; now >= expires_at (bad_request); lease_secret not the request lease key, or AEAD failure (decrypt_failed); payload not canonical or invalid (bad_request); a var not in requested_vars (forbidden). request_invalid: openLeaseRequest MUST fail with expect_error. grant_invalid: openLeaseGrant MUST fail with expect_error.
